is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae s.s., and An. coluzzii) in Senegal.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc-1014F, Vgsc-1014S, and Ace-1 G119S (referred to as G280S/119S).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 5, 6, 7, and 8 provide detailed genotype and allele frequency data with sample sizes (n) for various populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in central Senegal (IRS and control districts).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data collected in 2013 and 2014.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided at the district level (e.g., Koungheul, Koumpentoum, Malem Hodar, Nioro, Kaffrine, Ndoffane).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers a collection period from 2013 to 2014.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, original field collection and analysis conducted in 2013-2014.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is contained within the provided tables in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of IRS with bendiocarb and pirimiphos-methyl on insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in central Senegal between 2013 and 2014. It reports susceptibility status and genotype frequencies for kdr (1014F, 1014S) and ace-1 (G119S) mutations across multiple districts.
